'''''Wyvern'' battle group''' was an [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] centered on the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Wyvern]]'' that took part in the [[Second Battle of Fondor]].

After the surrender of the [[Fondorian]] forces, the ''Wyvern'' battle group almost followed the command of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] to renew hostilities against the Fondorian forces, only to be recalled back to their positions by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. It is likely that the battle group joined Darth Caedus after Pellaeon's death.
